summary: Iteration 7 (Hayah Energy PWA/checklist/photos/QR) fully tested. 14/14 backend pytest cases pass (GET/PUT checklist, POST/DELETE photo, 10MB limit, 404 for invalid project, manifest.json + sw.js served correctly). Frontend end-to-end validated: login, /operacional loads with QR + Open buttons, QR modal opens with SVG QR code, navigation to /projeto/:id works, ProjectDetailPage renders checklist items (pd-check-material/team) and toggles persist via PUT, photo upload UI (pd-photo-label + pd-photo-add) present, and Service Worker registers successfully (1 active registration). APScheduler confirmed running both jobs: morning_shutdown_check (08:30) + daily_scheduled_email (18:00) in America/Cuiaba timezone.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1305 lines — should be split into modules (auth, projects, checklist, photos, scheduler) for maintainability.
Photos stored as base64 data_url inside the project document could bloat the doc quickly (Mongo doc limit 16MB). Consider GridFS or object storage in future iterations.

OperacionalPage stores a separate local checklist state (localStorage 'operacional_checklists') that is not synced with the backend checklist saved via ProjectDetailPage. Two sources of truth for the same concept can confuse users.
morning_shutdown_check_job only runs if NOTIFICATION_EMAILS is set; when RESEND_API_KEY is empty (current env) emails are silently skipped — acceptable for now but should be documented.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_iter7_project via fixture (auto-deleted at module teardown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter7 endpoints /api/operacional/checklist/{id} and /api/operacional/photos/{id} all pass. PWA sw.js + manifest.json served OK. Frontend routes /projeto/:id and QR modal (op-qr-, qr-modal, qr-close) verified. Note: OperacionalPage has a local-only checklist (localStorage) that is separate from the backend-synced checklist on ProjectDetailPage — flagged as potential UX confusion but not a bug per current spec.
